description: English edition of the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) integration for VS Code. Embeds the DSH Web GUI in a sidebar or editor tab, auto-detects and starts dsh for you, and registers DSH as a Copilot chat model so Copilot can hand tasks to DSH’s agent. This edition is translated from the upstream Chinese project and tracks it automatically.
configuration.properties.dshPanel.url.de: URL of the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI (local, or forwarded over an SSH tunnel).
configuration.properties.dshPanel.host.d: Host address to bind when the extension starts dsh automatically.
configuration.properties.dshPanel.port.d: Port to listen on when the extension starts dsh automatically.
configuration.properties.dshPanel.autoSt: Start dsh automatically by running `dsh web` when it is detected that DSH is not running.
configuration.properties.dshPanel.autoRe: Register the current VS Code workspace as a DSH workspace, so new sessions default to it.
configuration.properties.dshPanel.openSy: Keep the old behaviour of popping open a system browser when the extension starts dsh web. Off by default: recent dsh web builds are authenticated automatically by the extension and used inside the panel.
configuration.properties.dshPanel.instal: Automatically install the bundled dsh-webview-clipboard plugin, which fixes broken editing shortcuts such as copy and paste inside the panel on macOS. The file is inert on Windows and Linux. Turn this off to check whether it affects dsh web startup.
configuration.properties.dshPanel.autoIn: When dsh is not installed in the current environment (including a remote server), prompt and install it on your behalf (npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh).
configuration.properties.dshPanel.dshCom: The dsh command. Resolved from PATH by default; set a full path if needed, for example C:\Users\you\AppData\Roaming\npm\dsh.cmd.
configuration.properties.dshPanel.killOn: End the dsh process started by this extension when the extension is deactivated or VS Code closes. dsh instances you started yourself are not affected.
configuration.properties.dshPanel.chatAg: Agent preset used when creating a DSH model session (for example liangshen). Leave empty to use the default preset from your DSH settings.
configuration.properties.dshPanel.chatPr: Model provider (provider id) used by the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) model entry. It must already be configured in your DSH settings, for example deepseek-official. Leave empty to follow the DSH default model.
configuration.properties.dshPanel.chatMo: Model id used by the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) model entry, together with chatProvider (for example deepseek-v4-pro). Leave empty to follow the DSH default model.
configuration.properties.dshPanel.chatTi: Maximum time to wait for a single task, in milliseconds. On timeout the task keeps running in the DSH panel.
configuration.properties.dshPanel.chatSy: How many minutes back to scan for modified chat session files when locating the current Copilot chat.
configuration.properties.dshPanel.enable: Register DSH as a VS Code chat model, so that DSH (DeepSeek Harness) appears in the model picker and selecting it lets DSH solve the task.
configuration.properties.dshPanel.debugM: Debug: write the structure of the messages VS Code sends to the DSH model into the workspace .dsh-debug/ directory.
configuration.properties.dshPanel.markFo: When switching back to the DSH model and re-sending the intermediate conversation, label answers produced by other models with "[Answer from another Copilot model]" so DSH can tell which answers it did not generate. Turn this off to disable the label.
configuration.properties.dshPanel.dshRea: Fallback reasoning effort for the DSH model: off/low/high/max. A choice made in the chat UI takes precedence; this setting only applies when nothing was chosen there. Leave empty to follow the DSH default.
